title: Pamphlet Rhetoric, Journalistic Feuds, and Satirical Sharpness

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: From Bessenyei and Kazinczy's language battles to Ady's and Ignotus's literary warfare, print polemic (*tollharc*) was Hungary's primary engine of cultural renewal. The pamphlet (*röpirat*) offered rapid circulation of radical ideas outside institutional censorship.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: Pamphlet style relies on punchy, staccato clauses, biting satire, and moral indictments designed to mobilize public opinion (*közvélemény*).

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: A röpirat óriási társadalmi visszhangot váltott ki...

In the crossfire of newspaper polemics...
